PharmR line 1105 (IL-6 up on SD1 in 15/16) and label IRR 34-40% verified. First public 2017 after ocrelizumab's own IRRs: retro; iv, unselected. Same status as safety 2, so no change of status on the track.

missing: Safety, same track (cyno-bcell-depletion-tox), 2017 'same': the ocrelizumab monkey PK/PD study 02-082-0352 (761053 PharmR p.12, bundle line ~1101) found 'IL-6 levels were increased on SD1 at 2 hours post-dose in 15 of 16 animals', with fewer elevations after the second dose. That matches the first-infusion reactions in patients (34.3% in OPERA, Hauser 2017 PMID 28002679; Ocrevus label 5.1). It belongs before the 2022 ublituximab contra, and it shows the ublituximab study's repeat-dose-only sampling, not the species, is why no cytokines were seen.

Efficacy track missing: marmoset EAE (rhMOG/CFA) with late B-cell depletion by HuMab 7D8, a sibling human anti-CD20 that cross-reacts with marmoset CD20. Kap et al. 2010 J Immunol, doi 10.4049/jimmunol.1001393 (PMID 20739677), reported it 'halts the development of EAE'; it pairs with Kappos 2011 (ocrelizumab phase 2, 2011). Follow-up: Kap 2014 J Immunol doi 10.4049/jimmunol.1303125. product_in_model false.

Efficacy, possible earlier track (not verified this session): mouse MOG35-55 EAE with mouse anti-CD20 (Matsushita et al. 2008 JCI). Depletion before induction exacerbated EAE and depletion after onset reduced it. Mixed predictions; if added, model_first_use_year for EAE moves to 2008.
Engagement: the huCD20 transgenic mouse PK/PD in the 761053 PharmR (line 206) is a second B-cell depletion system with no track; low priority.

Ocrelizumab monkey toxicology published prospectively: Vugmeyster et al. 2005 J Immunother 28:212 (doi 10.1097/01.cji.0000155050.03916.04, PMID 15838377), PRO70769 10-100 mg/kg IV, 'Depletion of CD20-expressing cells and lymphoid follicular atrophy were the only treatment-related effects'. Its 2005 tolerability statement is a prospective safety prediction on the cyno ocrelizumab track (silent on infection, later seen in patients) and the source for dose 2's margin.
rule_questions: Safety: a primate study measured cytokines only after repeated dosing (ublituximab), and the class's harm is a first-infusion effect. Does 'silence on a harm the species could have shown' cover a study design that sampled outside the harm's window? Another member's monkeys did show first-dose IL-6. Under the current rules the 2022 contra stands and beats the missing 2017 ocrelizumab 'same'.

Efficacy: one paper (Weber 2010) gives opposite anti-CD20 effects in two EAE paradigms (rMOG improved, MOG p35-55 worsened). Do they count as one model with a mixed prediction, or two model_ids where only the B-cell-dependent paradigm is a class prediction? The draft chose the rMOG arm alone.

Efficacy: the class entered MS on rituximab's phase 2 (HERMES, 2008), a same-target non-member in MS patients. Is that a cross_indication or sibling-drug 'model' track, or out of scope because rituximab is not a member?
Dose: what should magnitude be for a margin_stated 'same' when the margin held with ~12-fold headroom? within_2x reads as prediction accuracy.
